name: Marion County, OR
findings: Marion County has 1,068 nonprofit organizations. 453 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 367 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Marion County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 20 arts and cultural organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
